primary_source.author: Paul Bourgade
primary_source.title: Random band matrices
primary_source.model: H_RS = Delta + lambda V on Z^d; V(x) iid, centered, variance 1; lambda>0
primary_source.infinite_volume_target: Existence of absolutely continuous spectrum (extended states) in d=3 at sufficiently small disorder.
primary_source.finite_volume_target: GOE microscopic bulk eigenvalue statistics for periodic-box restrictions H_RS^N.
primary_source.source_caution: The survey reports both as open in 2018 and explicitly says that a.c. spectrum would not by itself explain GOE. It does not specify a full class of single-site laws for a theorem to prove.

intake.scope_caution: The intake combines a.c. spectrum and GOE in one problem; the 2018 source treats them as distinct unresolved questions.

recent_primary_literature.title: Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for Weak-Disorder Anderson Models in Dimensions at Least Three
recent_primary_literature.author: OpenAI
recent_primary_literature.claim: For each fixed d>=3 and sufficiently small fixed lambda>0, iid uniform site potentials give almost-surely purely a.c. spectrum with nonzero weight on a nonempty open interval independent of lambda.
recent_primary_literature.scope: Uniform site potentials only; no GOE or diffusion conclusion in the preprint.
recent_primary_literature.verification: Existence and stated scope checked against the authors' primary text; mathematical correctness has not been independently checked by w485.
recent_primary_literature.repository_caution: The repository README says unformalized results could have issues; no Anderson entry was found in its formalization catalogue by exact-title or Anderson text search. Absence of a catalogue hit is not a proof audit.
